verdict.rationale: Kong's plugin system supports request/response transformation plugins that can massage data in pre-request and post-response phases (kong-gh-3), but this is aimed at gateway-level traffic shaping, not developer-facing scripting to chain arbitrary requests together like a test/automation script. No evidence of a scripting environment (e.g., pre-request/test scripts referencing prior response data) comparable to API client tools. Missing for 10: explicit scripting API for chaining requests, examples of referencing prior response data in subsequent requests, and developer-facing script editor/console.
